title: Token-2022 Transfer-Fee Payment Reconciler
description: Recomputes the transfer fee a Token-2022 mint with the transfer-fee extension withholds and the net amount the recipient receives, given the fee schedule, the TransferChecked amount, the execution epoch and the amount a payment verifier credited, then reconciles the credited amount against that net: MATCH, OVER_CREDITED (the Kora GHSA-725g defect class, a verifier crediting the pre-fee amount) or UNDER_CREDITED, with credited_minus_net reported. All amounts are decimal strings computed in BigInt (128-bit intermediates, no floats). The output also records a declared-fee FeeMismatch for TransferCheckedWithFee, an epoch-schedule divergence when the verifier used a different schedule than the execution epoch, and an informational consumer view showing where the x402 SVM gross-amount path and the balance-delta net path disagree.

older_transfer_fee.description: Schedule used before the switch epoch: { epoch, maximum_fee, transfer_fee_basis_points }, all decimal strings (u64; basis points u16).

newer_transfer_fee.description: Schedule used from its epoch on: { epoch, maximum_fee, transfer_fee_basis_points }, all decimal strings. Applies when execution_epoch >= this epoch.

amount.description: The TransferChecked amount, i.e. pre-fee, in base units. Decimal string in u64 range.

execution_epoch.description: The Clock epoch in which the transfer executes. Decimal string in u64 range.

instruction.description: The checked transfer instruction. Unchecked transfers are refused: they fail with MintRequiredForTransfer on a mint carrying the fee extension.

declared_fee.description: TransferCheckedWithFee only: the fee the instruction states. A mismatch is recorded as FeeMismatch.

credited_amount.description: What the payment verifier credited, in base units. Decimal string in u64 range.

verifier_epoch.description: Optional: the epoch the verifier used for its fee. A different schedule pick than the execution epoch emits EPOCH_SCHEDULE_DIVERGENCE.

required_amount.description: Optional: the payee's required amount, for the informational x402 consumer view (gross-accept static path vs net-accept balance-delta path).

input_schema_provenance: Top-level properties are exactly the policy_parameters members the kernel reads: older_transfer_fee, newer_transfer_fee, amount, execution_epoch, instruction, declared_fee, credited_amount, verifier_epoch, required_amount.
author: PostOakLabs

output_example.note: Fee arithmetic ports the Token-2022 transfer-fee extension: ceiling(amount * bps / 10,000) capped at maximum_fee, computed in 128-bit intermediates, with the newer schedule applying from its epoch on. The Kora GHSA-725g defect class is a verifier crediting the pre-fee amount; OVER_CREDITED with credited_minus_net = fee reproduces it.
